_comment: One row set, two readers. `speech` is the verdict both sides must reach for each row: the frontend's isCrewmateSpeech / isCrewmateChatRow (website/src/components/chat/crewmateBubbles.ts) decides what a crewmate's chat DRAWS, the backend's is_speech_row (src/kiro_crew/dashboard/system_notices.py) decides what the Crew Members roster QUOTES. crew-mode.md ('A crewmate's chat') promises the two agree; this fixture is the pin. Add a row here first when either side learns a new status kind. Rows the frontend classifies as speech only while streaming (`role: streaming`) are frontend-only and carry `frontend_only: true`.
